legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro.title: Introduction
legal.privacy.intro.body: Souq Arab EU respects your privacy. This notice explains how personal data is handled when you use the marketplace, messaging, and account tools.
legal.privacy.s00.title: Controller and Contact
legal.privacy.s00.body: Data controller: MOHAMMAD ABU KHSHAIT, Germany. Primary service name: Souq Arab EU. Email: souqarab.market@gmail.com.
legal.privacy.s01.title: Data We Collect
legal.privacy.s01.body: We collect only data needed to provide and secure Souq Arab EU.
legal.privacy.s01.i1: Account data: name, email, password hash, and language.
legal.privacy.s01.i2: Profile data: avatar, bio, preferences, and optional social links.
legal.privacy.s01.i3: Listing data: ad content, photos, category, and pricing details.
legal.privacy.s01.i4: Order data: order state, timestamps, and delivery or pickup choices.
legal.privacy.s01.i5: Shipping data: recipient name, address, and contact details provided for delivery.
legal.privacy.s01.i6: Security data: 2FA status, trusted devices, active sessions, and security log events.
legal.privacy.s01.i7: Chat data: messages, attachments, abuse reports, and moderation actions.
legal.privacy.s01.i8: Location data: city, region, and optional shared map location.
legal.privacy.s01.i9: Visibility data: seller phone number when the seller chooses to show it publicly.
legal.privacy.s02.title: Why We Process Data
legal.privacy.s02.body: Processing is limited to service delivery, safety, and legal compliance.
legal.privacy.s02.i1: Create and secure user accounts, including login and recovery flows.
legal.privacy.s02.i2: Publish listings, match buyers and sellers, and process orders and shipping.
legal.privacy.s02.i3: Support chat, notifications, location sharing, and dispute handling.
legal.privacy.s02.i4: Detect fraud, enforce policies, and investigate security incidents.
legal.privacy.s02.i5: Comply with legal duties, accounting rules, and law-enforcement requests where applicable.
legal.privacy.s03.title: Legal Bases
legal.privacy.s03.body: We process data under contract necessity, legitimate interests in marketplace security, legal obligations, and consent where a feature is optional.
legal.privacy.s04.title: Account and Identity
legal.privacy.s04.body: You must provide accurate account details. We may request additional verification when activity suggests account compromise, fraud, or policy abuse.
legal.privacy.s05.title: Orders and Shipping
legal.privacy.s05.body: Order and shipping data is used to complete transactions, coordinate delivery, provide support, and resolve buyer-seller issues.
legal.privacy.s06.title: Security Controls
legal.privacy.s06.body: Souq Arab EU uses protective controls such as session monitoring, device history, optional two-factor authentication, and security logs to prevent unauthorized access.
legal.privacy.s07.title: Chat, Calls, and Abuse Prevention
legal.privacy.s07.body: Marketplace chat may be reviewed by authorized staff when needed for abuse reports, fraud checks, legal requests, or platform safety investigations.
legal.privacy.s08.title: Location, Maps, and Geocoding
legal.privacy.s08.body: Map-related features use OpenStreetMap data and CARTO tiles. City-level geocoding may optionally use Nominatim when you add or update location details.
legal.privacy.s08.i1: OpenStreetMap provides base geographic data for map display.
legal.privacy.s08.i2: CARTO provides rendered map tiles shown in the app.
legal.privacy.s08.i3: Nominatim may be used for optional city geocoding.
legal.privacy.s08.i4: Location sharing is optional and controlled by account or listing settings.
legal.privacy.s08.i5: Exact device GPS is not required for normal browsing and posting.
legal.privacy.s08.i6: You can edit or remove stored location fields from your profile or listing.
legal.privacy.s09.title: Cookies and Local Storage
legal.privacy.s09.body: We use cookies or similar browser storage for authentication, language, safety preferences, and essential product behavior.
legal.privacy.s10.title: Subprocessors
legal.privacy.s10.body: We use carefully selected processors to run Souq Arab EU under contractual controls.
legal.privacy.s10.i1: Hetzner: infrastructure hosting and core server operations.
legal.privacy.s10.i2: Supabase: authentication, database, and file storage services.
legal.privacy.s10.i3: Vercel: web app delivery and edge platform services.
legal.privacy.s10.i4: Resend: transactional email delivery such as verification and alerts.
legal.privacy.s10.i5: Each processor is bound by data protection obligations.
legal.privacy.s10.i6: Processor access is limited to what is necessary for service operation.
legal.privacy.s11.title: Retention and Deletion
legal.privacy.s11.body: Retention periods depend on account activity, legal duties, and dispute risk.
legal.privacy.s11.i1: Account profile data is retained while the account remains active.
legal.privacy.s11.i2: Completed or cancelled order records are retained for compliance and dispute handling.
legal.privacy.s11.i3: Draft listings can be removed when you delete your account.
legal.privacy.s11.i4: Security logs are retained for fraud prevention and incident response.
legal.privacy.s11.i5: Session and device metadata are retained for account protection.
legal.privacy.s11.i6: Chat content may be retained according to safety and legal requirements.
legal.privacy.s11.i7: When deletion is required, data is deleted or irreversibly anonymized.
legal.privacy.s12.title: Your Rights
legal.privacy.s12.body: Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, restriction, objection, portability, or deletion of personal data.
legal.privacy.s13.title: Children
legal.privacy.s13.body: Souq Arab EU is not intended for users who are under the minimum legal age to form a binding service agreement in their jurisdiction.
legal.privacy.s14.title: Policy Updates
legal.privacy.s14.body: We may update this policy when products, legal obligations, or security practices change. The last updated date indicates the current version.
legal.privacy.contact.title: Privacy Contact
legal.privacy.contact.body: For privacy requests or complaints, email souqarab.market@gmail.com.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
legal.terms.intro.title: Introduction
legal.terms.intro.body: These Terms govern your use of Souq Arab EU marketplace services, including listings, chat, orders, and account tools.
legal.terms.s00.title: Provider Information
legal.terms.s00.body: Souq Arab EU is operated by MOHAMMAD ABU KHSHAIT, Germany. Contact: souqarab.market@gmail.com.
legal.terms.s01.title: Acceptance of Terms
legal.terms.s01.body: By creating an account or using Souq Arab EU, you agree to these Terms and related policies.
legal.terms.s02.title: Account Responsibilities
legal.terms.s02.body: You are responsible for all actions performed through your account.
legal.terms.s02.i1: Provide accurate registration and profile information.
legal.terms.s02.i2: Keep credentials confidential and enable 2FA when available.
legal.terms.s02.i3: Review and close unknown sessions or devices immediately.
legal.terms.s03.title: Listing Rules
legal.terms.s03.body: Listings must be lawful, truthful, and relevant to the selected category.
legal.terms.s03.i1: Do not post prohibited, misleading, or stolen goods.
legal.terms.s03.i2: Provide clear pricing, condition, and delivery information.
legal.terms.s03.i3: Keep listing content respectful and free from harassment.
legal.terms.s04.title: Seller Obligations
legal.terms.s04.body: Sellers must fulfill accepted orders and communicate honestly.
legal.terms.s04.i1: Ship or deliver items within agreed timelines.
legal.terms.s04.i2: Use accurate shipping addresses and recipient details.
legal.terms.s04.i3: Seller phone numbers may be visible publicly when enabled by the seller.
legal.terms.s04.i4: Resolve buyer issues in good faith through platform channels.
legal.terms.s05.title: Buyer Obligations
legal.terms.s05.body: Buyers must act honestly and respect transaction commitments.
legal.terms.s05.i1: Submit correct shipping and contact information.
legal.terms.s05.i2: Pay agreed amounts and respond to order confirmations.
legal.terms.s05.i3: Use chat respectfully and avoid abusive communication.
legal.terms.s05.i4: Report disputes with complete and truthful evidence.
legal.terms.s06.title: Prohibited Conduct
legal.terms.s06.body: You may not misuse the service or harm other users.
legal.terms.s06.i1: No fraud, impersonation, phishing, or unauthorized access attempts.
legal.terms.s06.i2: No scraping, malware, or interference with platform security.
legal.terms.s06.i3: No unlawful content, hate speech, or threats of violence.
legal.terms.s07.title: Orders and Transaction Status
legal.terms.s07.body: Order states, shipping milestones, and completion records are part of the transaction history and may be retained for compliance.
legal.terms.s08.title: Communications and Notifications
legal.terms.s08.body: You agree to receive service notices by email and in-app channels. Push notifications may be delivered through browser or operating-system services when enabled.
legal.terms.s09.title: Safety, Sessions, and Enforcement
legal.terms.s09.body: We may investigate behavior that risks users or platform integrity.
legal.terms.s09.i1: We may review security logs, session history, and device data.
legal.terms.s09.i2: We may limit features during fraud or abuse investigations.
legal.terms.s09.i3: We may remove content that violates law or policy.
legal.terms.s09.i4: Serious or repeated violations may lead to suspension or termination.
legal.terms.s10.title: Third-Party Services
legal.terms.s10.body: Certain features rely on third-party providers such as hosting, authentication, email delivery, and map display providers including OpenStreetMap and CARTO.
legal.terms.s11.title: Intellectual Property
legal.terms.s11.body: Platform software, branding, and design are protected by applicable law. Users retain rights to their own lawful content while granting needed service licenses.
legal.terms.s12.title: Disclaimers and Liability Limits
legal.terms.s12.i1: Souq Arab EU does not guarantee uninterrupted availability or error-free operation.
legal.terms.s12.i2: To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to foreseeable direct damages.
legal.terms.s13.title: Account Suspension and Termination
legal.terms.s13.body: We may suspend or terminate accounts for legal violations, fraud, repeated abuse, or serious risk to users and platform security.
legal.terms.s14.title: Governing Law and Venue
legal.terms.s14.body: These Terms are governed by the laws applicable in Germany, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections under applicable law.
legal.terms.s15.title: Changes to Terms
legal.terms.s15.body: We may modify these Terms. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised version.
legal.terms.s16.title: Complaints and Support
legal.terms.s16.body: Use in-app support for case handling and include relevant order, shipping, chat, and account details for faster review.
legal.terms.contact.title: Legal Contact
legal.terms.contact.body: For legal notices or complaints, email souqarab.market@gmail.com.
legal.delete.title: Delete Account Policy
legal.delete.intro.title: Introduction
legal.delete.intro.body: Souq Arab EU provides account deletion through Settings → Privacy → Delete Account (not Settings → Delete Account). This policy explains eligibility, restrictions, and data effects.
legal.delete.s00.title: Controller and Contact
legal.delete.s00.body: Data controller: MOHAMMAD ABU KHSHAIT, Germany. Service: Souq Arab EU. Contact: souqarab.market@gmail.com.
legal.delete.s01.title: Who Can Request Deletion
legal.delete.s01.body: Only the authenticated account owner can submit a deletion request from inside the account settings.
legal.delete.s02.title: Checks Before Deletion
legal.delete.s02.body: The system runs automatic checks before processing account deletion.
legal.delete.s02.i1: Identity verification may require password re-entry and active 2FA confirmation.
legal.delete.s02.i2: The request is blocked while there are active orders requiring fulfillment or response.
legal.delete.s02.i3: Open disputes or chargeback workflows may delay deletion until resolved.
legal.delete.s02.i4: Required compliance records are preserved according to legal obligations.
legal.delete.s02.i5: You should export or save important data before confirming deletion.
legal.delete.s03.title: Active Orders Rule
legal.delete.s03.body: If your account has active orders, deletion cannot be completed until those orders are closed, completed, or otherwise resolved.
legal.delete.s04.title: Completed and Cancelled Orders
legal.delete.s04.body: Completed or cancelled order records are retained when required, but personal account identifiers are removed or irreversibly anonymized where possible.
legal.delete.s05.title: Draft Listings
legal.delete.s05.body: Draft listings and unpublished ad drafts are removed as part of deletion processing.
legal.delete.s06.title: Security Confirmation
legal.delete.s06.body: For account safety, deletion may require recent authentication, session verification, and optional device checks.
legal.delete.s07.title: Data Deleted or Disabled
legal.delete.s07.body: The following data is deleted or disabled when deletion is finalized:
legal.delete.s07.i1: Login credentials, profile fields, and account preferences.
legal.delete.s07.i2: Saved sessions, trusted devices, and active login tokens.
legal.delete.s07.i3: Draft listings, saved searches, and optional location-sharing preferences.
legal.delete.s07.i4: Public seller profile visibility including optional phone visibility.
legal.delete.s07.i5: Notification settings and push delivery links.
legal.delete.s07.i6: Chat access tied directly to the deleted account identity.
legal.delete.s07.i7: Non-required attachments and temporary support artifacts.
legal.delete.s07.i8: Other personal data not required for legal retention.
legal.delete.s08.title: Data Retained for Legal Reasons
legal.delete.s08.body: Some data may be retained with restricted access when required by law or legitimate security needs.
legal.delete.s08.i1: Records tied to tax, accounting, anti-fraud, or audit duties.
legal.delete.s08.i2: Evidence relevant to unresolved legal claims or enforcement requests.
legal.delete.s08.i3: Security logs needed to detect abuse or defend platform integrity.
legal.delete.s08.i4: Minimal metadata required to prove deletion execution and timing.
legal.delete.s09.title: Marketplace Effects
legal.delete.s09.body: Deletion changes how historical marketplace data appears.
legal.delete.s09.i1: Past chat threads may remain for counterparties with anonymized participant identity.
legal.delete.s09.i2: Order timelines may remain with non-identifying references for compliance.
legal.delete.s09.i3: Reviews or moderation outcomes may be retained in de-identified form.
legal.delete.s09.i4: You lose access to account features, purchase history views, and seller tools.
legal.delete.s10.title: Finalization and Recovery
legal.delete.s10.body: After deletion is finalized, account access cannot be restored. A new account requires fresh registration and new consent.
legal.delete.s11.title: Support Alternatives
legal.delete.s11.body: If you only want to stop notifications or hide profile details, you can change privacy, session, and communication settings without deleting the account.
legal.delete.footer: Deletion path: Settings → Privacy → Delete Account. For help with blocked deletion requests, contact souqarab.market@gmail.com.
